title: Ruby Stone Song
style: Phonk with dusty 808 bounce, eerie minor-key synth loop, clipped handclaps, and a slow head-nod swing; verse rides sparse drums and sub-bass, pre-chorus lifts with filtered bells and breathy doubles, chorus hits with stacked kid-friendly chants and a warped lead; bridge opens to half-time pads, whispered ad-libs, and a rising reverse swell before the final drop. Close-mic intimate vocal, gritty in verses, warm layered harmonies on hooks, with tape hiss and crystal chimes between lines and a dark, glossy mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ruby, little ruby
Michelle and Corey sing
You got a fire name
And a bright red ring

Born from deep inside
Of earth and time and stone
Under pressure, you
Learned how to glow

[Pre-Chorus]
Kings once wore you close
On crowns and hidden hands
People made a wish
When you crossed their plans

They said you guard the heart
They said you wake the brave
Tiny red kingdom
In a tiny brave frame

[Chorus]
Ruby, ruby, shine
Little ruby of mine
Ruby, ruby, shine
Red as a valentine

Ruby, ruby, shine
You make the dark look kind
Ruby, ruby, shine
My little ruby

[Verse 2]
Long ago in old lands
They traded you by name
From river beds to royal chests
You kept your flame

Some called you a shield
Against fear and night
Some said you could pull
Dreams into the light

Carved in wedding rings
And kept by warrior queens
Held like a promise
In the folds of dreams

[Pre-Chorus]
Even in old tales
They said you were alive
A spark in the blood
A red reason to survive

So when the world feels cold
And shadows come too near
Hold your little ruby heart
It knows the way from here

[Chorus]
Ruby, ruby, shine
Little ruby of mine
Ruby, ruby, shine
Red as a valentine

Ruby, ruby, shine
You make the dark look kind
Ruby, ruby, shine
My little ruby

[Bridge]
And if I look like you
It’s in the way I stay
Small but full of fire
Bright in my own way

I was built from love
Pressure, time, and care
Just like a ruby stone
I’m precious when I’m there

[Final Chorus]
Ruby, ruby, shine
Little ruby of mine
Ruby, ruby, shine
Red as a valentine

Ruby, ruby, shine
You make the dark look kind
Ruby, ruby, shine
My little ruby
